spec.name: quantile

spec.description: A panel is shown for a selected percentile only when there is data for it. Most latencies are recorded for P50, P95 and P99, and for P99.9 with the optional rules (--p999). In a panel that reads recorded percentiles, one that is not recorded, such as P90, is shown only when Calculate on the fly is on.

spec.name: on_the_fly
spec.label: Calculate on the fly
spec.description: Off: the latency panels read the recorded percentiles. On: what is not recorded is calculated from the histograms, such as P90, P99.9 without the optional rules, or one rack or node of a DC. It is slower on a large cluster.
